name: Woodwork
description: Cabinets and furniture in sheet goods: carcass generator and cut list.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Auto: a door, front, shelf or drawer picked changes that cabinet; a side, top, bottom or back picked, or nothing, makes a new one (next to it). The hint says which.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: By what is picked.

oneOf.title: Edit picked
oneOf.description: Its fields start as it is.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: A box, or a cabinet for a corner of the room.

oneOf.title: Corner, L-shaped
oneOf.description: Two fronts round the corner and a folding pair of doors.

oneOf.title: Corner, diagonal
oneOf.description: One front across the corner, one door.

oneOf.title: Sink base
oneOf.description: Rails instead of a top for the sink; no shelves.

corner.title: Corner
corner.description: Which corner of the room it fits in.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Right when placed right of a cabinet.

oneOf.title: Left
oneOf.description: The return runs along the left wall.

boards.title: Bottom, top, shelves
boards.description: How the L-shaped boards are cut.

oneOf.title: One piece
oneOf.description: A big corner may not fit on a sheet.

oneOf.title: Split in two
oneOf.description: Two dowelled rectangles each, to fit on a sheet.

units.title: Units
units.description: Inches fills the fields you have not changed with inch sizes.

width.title: Width
width.description: Outside width; a corner cabinet's length along the back wall.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Outside depth, back included; a corner cabinet's both arms.

thickness.title: Panel thickness
thickness.description: Thickness of the boards; 18 mm is usual.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: 0, 1, 2, or one per compartment, with 35 mm hinge cup holes.

door_hinge.title: First door hinged
door_hinge.description: The first door's hinge side; the rest alternate. With three overlay doors or more the end doors hinge on the sides and this is the side the first middle door hinges on.

corner_doors.title: Doors
corner_doors.description: The corner's doors, with 35 mm hinge cup holes.

oneOf.title: Hinged left
oneOf.description: At the left end, facing the corner.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: Alone they fill the front; with doors, above or below them.

drawer_height.title: Drawer front height
drawer_height.description: 0 is Auto: 150 mm beside doors, else all alike. Otherwise at least 100 mm (4 in): beside doors each drawer front; drawers only, the top front, the rest share what is left. Typical 140 to 150 mm.

drawers_at.title: Drawers at
drawers_at.description: Where the drawers go beside doors.

sizing.title: Size by
sizing.description: Outside: Width and Depth are the cabinet's. Drawer inside: they are worked out from the size you want inside the drawer boxes.

oneOf.title: Drawer inside
oneOf.description: Such as 672 x 672 mm for a 16 x 16 Gridfinity grid.

drawer_width.title: Drawer inside width
drawer_width.description: Inside a drawer box, side to side; it replaces Width.

drawer_depth.title: Drawer inside depth
drawer_depth.description: Inside a drawer box, front to back; it replaces Depth.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Upright boards splitting the inside into equal compartments.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: Shelves, evenly spaced; in each compartment.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: Rows of 5 mm holes, 32 mm apart, for movable shelves. Off: fixed shelves, joined like the dividers.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: The gap around the fronts, 0.5 to 6 mm.

handles.title: Drawer handles
handles.description: Handles on the drawer fronts: holes, a grip edge or groove, or a bottom tab.

oneOf.title: Pull
oneOf.description: Two holes 128 mm apart.

oneOf.title: Grip edge
oneOf.description: No handle: a 45° bevel behind the top edge (a door's on Handle position) to pull by.

oneOf.title: Finger groove
oneOf.description: No handle: a rounded groove along the front's top edge (a door's on Handle position).

oneOf.title: Bottom tab
oneOf.description: Drawers only, no handle: the drawer's bottom sticks out under the front as a rounded tab to pull by. Doors get none.

door_handles.title: Door handles
door_handles.description: Handles on the doors: holes, or a grip edge or groove.

oneOf.title: Pull
oneOf.description: Two holes 128 mm apart.

oneOf.title: Grip edge
oneOf.description: No handle: a 45° bevel behind the front's top or bottom edge (Handle position) to pull by.

oneOf.title: Finger groove
oneOf.description: No handle: a rounded groove along the front's top or bottom edge (Handle position).

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle goes. A grip edge or groove goes on the top or bottom edge, Middle on the top.

fronts.title: Fronts
fronts.description: Overlay: in front. Inset: in the opening.

front_style.title: Front style
front_style.description: Plain fronts, or grooves cut into their faces (shape, spacing and depth in Woodwork settings).

oneOf.title: Shaker
oneOf.description: A frame of stiles and rails round a thinner panel.

oneOf.title: Glass
oneOf.description: As Shaker, with a 4 mm glass pane in the frame instead of the panel.

wall_mount.title: Wall mount
wall_mount.description: How the cabinet hangs on the wall; a cleat or rail needs a back in a groove or none.

oneOf.title: French cleat
oneOf.description: A 45 degree cleat on the cabinet hooks over one on the wall.

oneOf.title: Hanging rail
oneOf.description: A plain 90 mm board to screw through into the wall.

oneOf.title: Steel rail
oneOf.description: A bought rail and hangers, in the cut list's hardware.

back.title: Back
back.description: The thin board at the back.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Each board's name written on it.

plinth.title: Plinth / toe kick
plinth.description: Yes: the plinth set in Woodwork settings. No: none, for a wall cabinet or one on top.

material.title: Material
material.description: Change single parts later with Material.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: New: the cabinet to match or stand against. Edit: a board of the cabinet to change.

place.title: Place
place.description: Where it goes: at the origin, against the selected cabinet, or along a line.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Against the selected side or top, else at the origin.

oneOf.title: Right of selected
oneOf.description: Backs flush; turned to continue a corner cabinet's return.

oneOf.title: Along a line
oneOf.description: Its back on a picked sketch line, edge or wall face, along X or Y.

line.title: Line
line.description: A sketch line, a model edge, or a wall face (its bottom edge).

start_at.title: Start at
start_at.description: Which end of the line, seen from the front, the cabinet starts from.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: From that end to the cabinet's side; at the middle, how far right of it.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: Away from the wall, or into the room a sketch line is drawn in; Flip turns it round.

width_from_line.title: Width from line
width_from_line.description: As wide as the line, less the offset; follows a sketch line's length dimension.

height_line.title: Height from line
height_line.description: Optional: as tall as this sketch line or edge (up to a window, say); follows its length dimension.

match.title: Match selected
match.description: Take height, depth, thickness and plinth from the selected cabinet, linked.

name.title: Name
name.description: A taken name gets the next free number.

selection.title: Selected
selection.description: A board of the cabinet, or the parts to change.

material.title: Material
material.description: What the boards are made of; the cut list groups by it.

oneOf.title: Whole cabinet
oneOf.description: Every board of the picked part's cabinet.

oneOf.title: Selected parts
oneOf.description: Only the picked parts.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: The side of the box cabinet that gets the panel.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A finishing board on the cabinet's end.

oneOf.title: End panel
oneOf.description: Over the side, floor to top, back to the fronts.

oneOf.title: Filler
oneOf.description: A strip beside the fronts closing a gap to a wall.

width.title: Filler width
width.description: How far the filler reaches out, its thickness included.

side.title: Side
side.description: Which end, seen from the front.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: The side you picked.

units.title: Units
units.description: Inches fills the fields you have not changed with inch sizes.

selection.title: Selected cabinets
selection.description: A board of each cabinet to stand on the base; none: the cabinets the base of this name stands under.

oneOf.title: Casters
oneOf.description: Locking casters, so it rolls.

oneOf.title: Feet
oneOf.description: Adjustable feet in the casters' places.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: A riser: the frame stands on the floor.

caster_height.title: Caster or foot height (mm)
caster_height.description: From the floor to the frame's underside: the casters or feet under it.

frame_material.title: Frame of
frame_material.description: Sheet-goods boards on edge, or solid timber in a common section.

oneOf.title: Timber
oneOf.description: Bought by length; the cut list gives the running metres per section.

timber_thickness.title: Timber thickness (mm)
timber_thickness.description: Across the frame. Common sections: Norway 48 x 98, 48 x 148; US 2x4 = 38 x 89.

timber_width.title: Timber width (mm)
timber_width.description: The frame's height, the timber standing on edge: 98 for a 48 x 98.

frame_height.title: Frame height (mm)
frame_height.description: How tall the frame's boards stand on edge.

thickness.title: Board thickness (mm)
thickness.description: The frame's boards; 18 mm is usual.

stiffener_spacing.title: Stiffener spacing (mm)
stiffener_spacing.description: The most between two boards across the frame; stiffeners are added evenly to keep within it. 600 is usual.

name.title: Name
name.description: Run again with this name to make it again, after a cabinet changed.

selection.title: Selected cabinets
selection.description: A board of each cabinet under it, or a worktop to redo.

units.title: Units
units.description: Inches fills the fields you have not changed with inch sizes.

joint.title: Corner joint
joint.description: How two pieces meet at a corner.

oneOf.title: Butt
oneOf.description: The longer piece runs through.

oneOf.title: Mitre
oneOf.description: Cut on the corner's diagonal.

front_overhang.title: Front overhang
front_overhang.description: Past the deepest front; doors stand 20 mm proud.

left_overhang.title: Left end overhang
left_overhang.description: Past the run's free left end.

right_overhang.title: Right end overhang
right_overhang.description: Past the run's free right end.

dog_holes.title: Dog holes
dog_holes.description: 20 mm holes, 96 mm apart, for bench dogs.

oneOf.title: All over
oneOf.description: Over the piece, 60 mm from its edges.

oneOf.title: In a zone
oneOf.description: In a rectangle you give.

zone_x.title: Zone from left
zone_x.description: From the left end to the zone.

zone_y.title: Zone from front
zone_y.description: From the front edge to the zone.

cutout.title: Cut-out
cutout.description: For a sink, hob or router plate.

oneOf.title: Rebated
oneOf.description: With a ledge at the top so a plate sits flush.

cutout_x.title: Opening from left
cutout_x.description: From the left end to the hole's middle.

cutout_y.title: Opening from front
cutout_y.description: From the front edge to the hole's middle.

rebate_width.title: Ledge width
rebate_width.description: How far the ledge reaches out from the hole.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: A benchtop tool on a shelf below an opening, its table flush.

oneOf.title: Benchtop tool, flush
oneOf.description: An opening, and a shelf on battens below.

tool_width.title: Tool width
tool_width.description: Along the piece, where it passes the top.

tool_height.title: Tool height
tool_height.description: From the tool's foot to its table.

tool_x.title: Tool from left
tool_x.description: From the left end to the tool's middle.

tool_y.title: Tool from front
tool_y.description: From the front edge to the tool's middle.

bolt_x.title: Bolt spacing across
bolt_x.description: Between the tool's feet, side to side: 8 mm bolt holes in its shelf. 0 for none.

bolt_y.title: Bolt spacing front to back
bolt_y.description: Between the tool's feet, front to back. 0 for none.

wing.title: Side wing
wing.description: The worktop carried on past an end of the run, on two legs, for long stock beside a tool.

wing_length.title: Wing length
wing_length.description: How far the wing reaches past the end.

name.title: Name
name.description: Running again with it replaces that worktop.

oneOf.title: Labels (PDF)
oneOf.description: 24 stickers on A4.

oneOf.title: DXF
oneOf.description: A drawing per sheet for a CNC.

diagrams.title: Cutting diagrams
diagrams.description: A drawing of each sheet in the PDF.

file.title: Save as
file.description: Saved in the folder approved at install.

selection.title: Selected cabinet
selection.description: Any board of the cabinet to draw.

scope.title: Draw
scope.description: A sheet per cabinet in the drawing Woodwork.

with.title: Build again
with.description: Each cabinet built again where it stands, as a long job with progress and Cancel (SolidCraft 0.48).

oneOf.title: With the settings
oneOf.description: The Woodwork settings stored now, where a cabinet's differ.

oneOf.title: As made
oneOf.description: Each with its own values, sizes from Parameters: after a Woodwork update.

selection.title: Cabinets
selection.description: Pick any part of each cabinet; several parts of one cabinet count once. Empty: all cabinets.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes below; kept in mm.

material.title: Material
material.description: New cabinets' material; Keep leaves it.

back.title: Back
back.description: New cabinets' back board: in a groove, overlaid or none.

oneOf.title: In a groove
oneOf.description: In a slot in the sides, top and bottom.

oneOf.title: Overlaid
oneOf.description: Screwed onto the rear edges.

back_thickness.title: Back thickness
back_thickness.description: Usually thinner than the rest, such as 6 mm.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Writes each board's cut list name on it.

fronts.title: Fronts
fronts.description: How new cabinets' doors and drawer fronts sit.

oneOf.title: Overlay
oneOf.description: In front, covering the board edges.

oneOf.title: Inset
oneOf.description: Inside the opening, flush.

reveal.title: Reveal (mm)
reveal.description: New cabinets' gap round the fronts, 0.5 to 6 mm.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where the handle holes go on a door.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Top on a floor unit, bottom on a wall unit.

grip_gap.title: Grip gap
grip_gap.description: With a grip edge, how far the front stops short of its grip edge, so a finger fits behind it: 5 to 50 mm.

front_style.title: Front style
front_style.description: New cabinets' fronts: plain, or grooves cut into their faces.

oneOf.title: Shaker
oneOf.description: A frame of stiles and rails round a thinner panel.

oneOf.title: Glass
oneOf.description: As Shaker, with a 4 mm glass pane in the frame instead of the panel.

groove_shape.title: Groove shape
groove_shape.description: Square: a flat bottom. Round: a half round, fluted. V: a 90 degree V, as wide as twice its depth.

groove_spacing.title: Groove spacing
groove_spacing.description: About how far apart the grooves are; evened out over each front.

groove_depth.title: Groove depth
groove_depth.description: How deep the grooves are; they are twice as wide.

frame_width.title: Frame width
frame_width.description: A shaker front's stiles and rails, 55 to 150 mm wide; a door's stile takes the hinge cups.

panel_thickness.title: Panel thickness
panel_thickness.description: The thinner panel in a shaker front's frame, set in a groove.

door_handles.title: Door handles
door_handles.description: New cabinets' door handles: holes, or a grip edge or groove.

oneOf.title: Pull
oneOf.description: Two holes 128 mm apart.

oneOf.title: Grip edge
oneOf.description: No handle: a 45° bevel behind the front's top or bottom edge (Handle position) to pull by.

oneOf.title: Finger groove
oneOf.description: No handle: a rounded groove along the front's top or bottom edge (Handle position).

hinge_angle.title: Hinge opening
hinge_angle.description: How far new cabinets' doors open.

double_dividers.title: Double dividers
double_dividers.description: Where two overlay doors meet on a divider: two boards side by side instead of one, so each door covers a whole board and takes standard hinges.

handles.title: Drawer handles
handles.description: New cabinets' drawer handles: holes, a grip edge or groove, or a bottom tab.

drawer_thickness.title: Drawer box thickness
drawer_thickness.description: The drawer boxes' sides, front and back, 10 to 25 mm, such as 12, 15 or 18 mm. The box gets narrower inside, not outside.

drawer_bottom.title: Drawer bottom thickness
drawer_bottom.description: The drawer boxes' bottoms, between the sides, 3 to 19 mm, such as 6 or 9 mm.

drawer_side_height.title: Drawer side height
drawer_side_height.description: How tall the drawer boxes' sides are; 0 keeps them as tall as the box. At least 50 mm.

drawer_back_height.title: Drawer back height
drawer_back_height.description: How tall the drawer boxes' backs are; 0 makes them as tall as the sides. Lower or taller than the sides, at most the box's height.

tab_width.title: Tab width
tab_width.description: With Drawer handles Bottom tab: how wide the drawer bottom's tab is, the part that sticks out under the front to pull by. Never wider than the box inside.

drawer_joints.title: Drawer box joints
drawer_joints.description: How new box cabinets' drawer boxes are joined at the corners.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: Butted boards, as before.

oneOf.title: Finger joints
oneOf.description: Interlocking fingers at the four corners; the front and back run through to the outside.

drawer_front.title: Drawer front
drawer_front.description: Whether new box cabinets' drawers get a front board of their own, or the box's front is the drawer front.

oneOf.title: Separate
oneOf.description: A front board on the drawer box, as before.

oneOf.title: Integrated
oneOf.description: No separate front: the box's front board is the front, sized and drilled as one.

slide_type.title: Slide type
slide_type.description: New cabinets' drawers: metal slides by how far they pull out, or dado runners (the bottom in a groove in the sides).

oneOf.title: Partial extension
oneOf.description: About three quarters out.

oneOf.title: Over-travel
oneOf.description: 25 mm further than full.

oneOf.title: Dado runners
oneOf.description: No slides: the bottom runs in a groove in each side.

oneOf.title: Strip runners
oneOf.description: No slides and no groove: the bottom runs on a wooden strip screwed to each side.

oneOf.title: Undermount partial
oneOf.description: Runners under the box: 42 mm narrower inside than the opening, sides 16 mm at most.

oneOf.title: Undermount full
oneOf.description: The same, pulling out fully.

strip_thickness.title: Strip thickness
strip_thickness.description: Strip runners: how thick the wooden strip on each side is, 6 to 30 mm. The drawer box gets narrower by it.

strip_height.title: Strip height
strip_height.description: Strip runners: how high the wooden strip under each drawer is, 10 to 60 mm.

plinth.title: Plinth / toe kick height
plinth.description: New cabinets' plinth height, when their Plinth is Yes.

plinth_setback.title: Plinth / toe kick set-back
plinth_setback.description: How far the plinth board or the notch is back from the front.

cleat_height.title: Cleat height
cleat_height.description: A French cleat's height on its long face.

cleat_thickness.title: Cleat thickness
cleat_thickness.description: A French cleat's thickness; the back moves forward by this much.

joints.title: Joinery
joints.description: How new cabinets' sides are fixed to the bottom and top.

oneOf.title: Finger joints
oneOf.description: Interlocking fingers at the corners, the top and bottom through to the outside.

joints_inner.title: Joinery inside
joints_inner.description: How new cabinets' dividers, fixed shelves and the rail under drawers are fixed.

joint_spacing.title: Joint spacing
joint_spacing.description: The most between two dowels or screws along a joint.

joint_edge.title: Joint edge distance
joint_edge.description: From the edges to the end dowels or screws.

dowel_d.title: Dowel diameter
dowel_d.description: 8 mm is usual in 18 mm boards.

dado_depth.title: Dado depth
dado_depth.description: Each board in a groove is that much longer at each end.

cam_bolt.title: Cam bolt length
cam_bolt.description: From the bolt's tip to the cam.

finger_width.title: Finger width
finger_width.description: How wide each finger of a finger joint is; 0 makes it as wide as the boards are thick. The count is odd, so the sides keep the outer fingers.

finger_bottom.title: Finger-joint the bottom too
finger_bottom.description: Off: over a plinth the bottom is butted, as fingers there would be closed mortises.

pocket_face.title: Pocket face
pocket_face.description: The face of the bottom and top new cabinets' pockets are drilled in.

oneOf.title: Outside
oneOf.description: Under the bottom, over the top: hidden.

banding.title: Edge banding
banding.description: The cut list's edge strip: fronts all round, other boards at the front.

cut_sizes.title: Cut list sizes
cut_sizes.description: The size the cut list gives a banded part.

oneOf.title: Finished
oneOf.description: As in the model.

oneOf.title: Cut
oneOf.description: Less the banding.

sheet.title: Sheet size
sheet.description: The sheets you buy, for the cutting layouts.

trim.title: Edge trim (mm)
trim.description: Cut off each sheet edge first.

worktop_material.title: Worktop material
worktop_material.description: What a new worktop is made of.

worktop_thickness.title: Worktop thickness
worktop_thickness.description: A new worktop's thickness; 38 mm is usual in a kitchen.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Optional, for a cost estimate in the cut list: name = price, separated by ; such as White melamine 18 = 42; Hinge = 3.2; Banding = 0.6. A sheet by material and thickness, banding a metre, hardware a piece.

hardware_models.title: Hardware models
hardware_models.description: Simple hinges and slides in new cabinets; not in the cut list.

oneOf.title: Shown, cutting the cups
oneOf.description: Needs SolidCraft 0.47; slower before.

fastener_models.title: Fastener models
fastener_models.description: Dowels, screws, cam locks and biscuits shown in new cabinets' holes, to look at with See-through boards; none when Hardware models is None.

see_through.title: See-through boards
see_through.description: Boards you can see through, to look at the joints and fittings inside; Oak stays solid.

camera.title: Camera after a run
camera.description: Whether a run frames what it built; Keep leaves it.
